sn7.16:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn7.16:1.2: tena kho pana samayena paccanikasāto nāma brāhmaṇo sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasati.
sn7.16:1.5: yaṃ yadeva samaṇo gotamo bhāsissati taṃ tadevassāhaṃ paccanikāssanti.
sn7.16:1.6: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā ajjhokāse caṅkamati.
sn7.16:1.7: atha kho paccanikasāto brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ caṅkamantaṃ anucaṅkamamāno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn7.16:4.1: evaṃ vutte paccanikasāto brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn7.16:4.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama. pe.
sn7.16:4.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
